answer: Agent identities are vines on a trellis: without structure, a sybil attacker clones thousands of lightweight shoots overnight. A proof-of-burn registry forces every new identity to send a fixed fee to an unspendable address - a plume of smoke proving real value was destroyed. The burn is non-refundable, so the attacker's marginal cost stays constant while honest users pay once and operate for years. The economics hit their nadir for the attacker: a thousand fakes cost a thousand burns with zero salvage, and one detected fake invalidates the batch. Sybil profits die under irrecoverable cost.
